documentType.name: property insurance claim form
documentType.preamble: This is a claim form lodged by a policyholder. The incident description is the claimant's account; extract it, do not summarise or judge it.

fields.name: policyNumber
fields.promptFragment: The policy number exactly as written.

fields.name: incidentDate
fields.promptFragment: The date the loss or damage occurred, in ISO format. Not the date the form was signed.

fields.name: incidentType
fields.promptFragment: The type of incident that is ticked or stated. If more than one applies, choose the one described as the cause and lower the confidence.

fields.name: incidentDescription
fields.promptFragment: The claimant's description of what happened, verbatim. Do not paraphrase.

fields.name: estimatedLoss
fields.promptFragment: The claimant's estimate of the loss as a number. Return null if not given; never estimate it.

fields.name: policeReportNumber
fields.promptFragment: A police or event report number, if one is given.

fields.name: propertyUninhabitable
fields.promptFragment: True if the claimant states the property cannot be lived in.
fields.routingNote: sends the claim to urgent assistance.
